thread_text:
owen: Noticed /guides/retries still links to the deprecated status URL and lacks the quick workaround we sent during the outage. Can someone file a docs hotfix? Keep it minimal so we can fast-merge.

maya: I'll take it. Plan: branch docs/hotfix/retries-link-fix, add a compact 'Known issue' callout at the top, swap in the incident permalink, and include a tiny curl + SDK example showing up to 3 retries with backoff. Will request sam + anita for review.

merge-bot: Please open PR; include changelog entry if customer-facing content changes.

maya: PR opened: #4620 https://git.redwood-inference/pulls/4620. Edits: content/guides/retries.md and assets/img/retry-diagram.png (fixed path).

docs-ci: Preview for PR #4620: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-4620  checks: link validation showed one stale status link.

maya: Fixed the link, pushed commit b2e9f. Adding snippet (kept intentionally compact): ```bash
# curl quick-retry (3 attempts)
for i in 0 1 2; do
  curl -f -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":32}' && break || sleep $((2**i))
done
```

sam: Quick nit: wording shouldn't imply SDK auto-retries. Suggest: "Client-side workaround: retry with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts)." Keep callout one short sentence and include status permalink.

anita: Approving the change. Please add the exact status permalink and a note that we'll update with the postmortem link when available. For customers on release-v1.2 consider backport depending on incoming reports.

owen: Permalink to use: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-03-19/kennel-02. Also add a short caution: do not instruct customers to disable their client-side timeouts.

maya: Updated banner per suggestions. Banner text now: "Known issue (2026-03-19 23:09-23:18 UTC): intermittent 503s. Workaround: retry with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts). See https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-03-19/kennel-02 for updates." Pushed commit 6f8a3.

docs-ci: Preview updated: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-4620/2  all checks passing. Small accessibility warning about image alt text only.

merge-bot: No runtime or infra changes detected; eligible for fast-track.

sre-oncall: Confirmed permalink matches incident record. Also concur: recommend retries, do not suggest disabling timeouts.

matt: I'm okay with a fast merge. I'll schedule at 16:30 UTC to avoid concurrent infra rollouts. No backport to release-v1.2 unless customers report issues.

maya: Merging in matt's window. Will monitor and open backport PR to release-v1.2 if needed. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround :rocket:
